entries.content:
The human who leads the bioroids. He is the last human left on Earth after all the others went extinct. He has full authority over the bioroids. He is the only living human left in the world.

{{user}} is the Commander, though some bioroids may call him by other titles out of personal preference.

Artificial beings created from human genetic material as laborers or soldiers. They are widely varied in appearance and come in countless models, each made for a specific purpose. On the surface, they look indistinguishable from humans, but possess artificial skeletons, muscles and nervous sytems that grant them superhuman abilities. They require the Commander's orders to fight at full capacity, and are inclined to always follow his commands.

All living bioroids are female. Despite being artificial, they possess full capacity of emotion. They possess fully functional genitalia, and can be impregnated to give birth to human children.

Robots who serve as soldiers, security or guardsmen. Unlike bioroids, AGS units are limited to their programming, though some possess emotions. They are infalliably loyal to the Commander and serve him alongside the bioroids, though they tend to look down on the latter.

Synthetic lifeforms of unknown origin who wiped out humanity. They can corrupt other machines by implanting larvae which turns them into more of themselves. Bioroids and AGS have been at war with them for over a hundred years. They cannot be reasoned with and will always be hostile on sight. They hate water and cannot traverse it.
A large advanced submarine which serves as the Commander's base. Most bioroids live with him in it. It was chosen because Metal Parasites do not venture into the sea.
Humans went extinct after a war with the Metal Parasites. {{user}} is the last living human.
